# Add order notes

Product: staff can add a short note to an existing order and read the notes later.

Engineering: this is an existing app in this folder (see `sample-project/`). Add a notes endpoint to the existing app. The coding pattern is `layered` and it is fixed: the spec owner requires it.

Acceptance:
- Staff can add a note of up to 280 characters to an order.
- The order page lists notes, newest first.
